cases.title: Gym roof drains added per RFI-112
cases.narrative: RFI-112 response adds two overflow roof drains at the gym roof. Plumbing sub to furnish and install.
cases.scope_context: Drawing P-201 shows four primary roof drains at the gym; no overflow drains are shown.

lines.desc: Overflow roof drain body and dome

cases.title: Fire-rated door hardware per ASI-014
cases.narrative: ASI-014 changes eight corridor doors to 90-minute assemblies with fire-rated hardware. ASI says no change in cost or time; CM gave notice that it adds cost.
cases.scope_context: Spec 08 71 00 lists standard (non-rated) hardware sets for corridor doors C101 to C108.

cases.title: Library data drops per Owner email
cases.narrative: Owner's Representative directed 24 added data drops in the library. Electrical sub with low-voltage lower-tier.
cases.scope_context: Drawing T-101 shows 12 data drops in the library.

cases.title: Delete covered walkway canopy (deductive)
cases.narrative: Owner deleted the covered walkway canopy at the bus loop. Credit from steel sub; Fee reduced at 5%.
cases.scope_context: Drawing S-401 shows a 60-foot steel canopy at the bus loop.

cases.title: Heavier stud gauge per submittal return
cases.narrative: Architect's comment on the framing submittal requires 18-gauge studs at the gym in place of 20-gauge. Framing sub prices the difference; CM rented a scissor lift.
cases.scope_context: Spec 09 22 16 allows 20-gauge studs for interior partitions up to 14 feet.

cases.title: Hallway ceiling access panels, T&M
cases.narrative: RFI-131 response adds 14 access panels. Done on T&M; the CM superintendent and Owner's Representative signed every tag. The tower crane was not used.
cases.scope_context: Reflected ceiling plan A-501 shows no access panels in corridors.

cases.title: Self-performed generator pad
cases.narrative: Architect's field order adds a concrete pad for the emergency generator. CM self-performs with its own crew and skid steer (daily logs attached).
cases.scope_context: Drawing E-001 shows the generator on grade with no pad.

cases.title: Added fire sprinkler heads at stage
cases.narrative: ASI-022 adds sprinkler heads at the stage rigging. Includes the fire marshal permit revision fee, bond and insurance, and B&O tax, all without Fee.
cases.scope_context: Drawing FP-102 shows no heads above the stage rigging.

cm_lines.desc: Bond and insurance premium at actual cost
Washington B&O tax at actual cost

cases.title: Added floor drains, kitchen
cases.narrative: RFI-140 adds three floor drains in the kitchen. Plumbing sub price includes 15% overhead and profit.
cases.scope_context: Drawing P-301 shows two floor drains in the kitchen.

cases.title: Classroom smartboard backing and power
cases.narrative: Owner directed blocking and power for 16 smartboards. Electrical sub marked up its lower-tier blocking contractor at 10%.
cases.scope_context: Drawings show whiteboards only; no smartboards.

cases.title: Added exterior lighting at parking
cases.narrative: Owner added four pole lights at the staff lot. Cover sheet applies the 5% Fee to everything, including bond, insurance, and B&O tax.
cases.scope_context: Drawing E-100 shows no lighting at the staff lot.

cases.title: Extra haul-off for abatement debris
cases.narrative: Asbestos mastic found under classroom flooring. Abatement sub price is fine; CM added dumpsters and haul-off and put the 5% Fee on them.
cases.scope_context: Hazardous materials survey did not identify mastic in classrooms 110 to 116.

cases.title: Add gym wall padding
cases.narrative: Owner added wall padding on two gym walls. Cover sheet Fee is 7.5%.
cases.scope_context: Spec 11 66 23 includes padding on the north wall only.

cases.title: Revised casework per ASI-031
cases.narrative: ASI-031 revises science room casework. CP includes Project Manager time to price the change and estimating time.
cases.scope_context: Drawing A-601 shows standard-height casework in rooms 201 and 203.

cases.title: Stair nosing replacement per RFI-152
cases.narrative: RFI-152 changes stair nosings at both stairs. Field supervision was provided by D. Alvarez, the CM's superintendent on this project.
cases.scope_context: Spec 09 65 13 calls for rubber nosings; RFI-152 changes them to aluminum abrasive nosings.

cases.title: Bleacher anchor revisions
cases.narrative: RFI-158 revises bleacher anchors. CM charged one of its project pickup trucks for material runs.
cases.scope_context: Drawing S-310 shows wedge anchors; RFI-158 requires epoxy anchors.

cases.title: Storm line reroute at playfield
cases.narrative: An abandoned concrete vault blocked the storm line. CM excavated around it with its own excavator, charged at the full Blue Book rate.
cases.scope_context: Civil drawings C-201 show no structures along the storm line route.

cases.title: Rooftop unit curb adapters per RFI-166
cases.narrative: RFI-166 adds curb adapters for two rooftop units. CP includes 6 hours of mobile hoisting to lift the adapters.
cases.scope_context: Drawing M-501 shows units set on existing curbs.

cases.title: Added classroom sinks per ASI-036
cases.narrative: ASI-036 adds sinks in two classrooms. CM self-performed blocking with a 45% labor burden.
cases.scope_context: Drawing P-210 shows no sinks in classrooms 105 and 107.

cases.title: Window film at south classrooms
cases.narrative: Owner added solar film at south classrooms. Cover sheet total is higher than the sum of its lines.
cases.scope_context: Spec 08 80 00 has clear glazing with no film.

cases.title: Corridor outlet additions, T&M
cases.narrative: Owner asked for added corridor outlets, done on T&M. Two of three tags lack the Owner's Representative's signature.
cases.scope_context: Drawing E-201 shows outlets at 40-foot spacing in corridors.

cases.title: Revised fire alarm devices per RFI-171
cases.narrative: RFI-171 response adds fire alarm strobes. CM gave notice on March 16; costs in the CP run from March 4.
cases.scope_context: Drawing FA-101 shows horn-only devices in classrooms.

cases.title: Door closers at corridor doors per RFI-175
cases.narrative: CM priced door closers for corridor doors C201 to C212 after RFI-175 confirmed closers are required.
cases.scope_context: Spec 08 71 00, hardware set HW-4 (used at C201 to C212), already includes a surface closer on each door. RFI-175 response: 'Closers are required per HW-4.'

cases.title: Permit delay, 12 days
cases.narrative: The building permit, which the Owner was responsible for obtaining, was issued 12 days late. CM claims 12 days of extended SGC at the contract daily rate, with no Fee.
cases.scope_context: Baseline schedule shows mobilization on 2020-01-06 as a critical path activity.

cases.title: Unsuitable soils at gym footing
cases.narrative: Soft organic soils found at gym footing F-12 before excavation continued. Over-excavate and replace with structural fill per geotech.
cases.scope_context: Geotechnical report assumed medium-dense sand at footing depth.

cases.title: Seismic bracing upgrade per ASI-040
cases.narrative: ASI-040 adds seismic bracing to mechanical and electrical systems across the building after a code review.
cases.scope_context: Drawings show bracing only at rooftop equipment.

cases.title: Weather-related delay with extended conditions
cases.narrative: CM claims 6 days of extended general conditions for a roofing delay and applies the 5% Fee to the extended SGC.
cases.scope_context: Schedule shows roofing on the critical path in November.

cases.title: Kitchen hood relocation per RFI-180
cases.narrative: RFI-180 moves the kitchen hood. CP charges NSS dumpsters with Fee, a CM-owned forklift at full Blue Book, and Project Engineer coordination hours.
cases.scope_context: Drawing M-401 shows the hood on the east wall.

cases.title: Added restroom partitions per ASI-044
cases.narrative: ASI-044 adds two toilet partitions. Notice given June 1; partition sub took 12% overhead and profit.
cases.scope_context: Drawing A-120 shows six partitions in restroom 140.

cases.title: Gym sound panels per Owner direction
cases.narrative: Owner added acoustic panels in the gym. Acoustics sub sent a lump-sum quote without a breakdown; cover sheet total also runs $950 high.
cases.scope_context: Spec 09 84 00 has no acoustic panels in the gym.

cases.title: Science room gas shutoffs per RFI-183
cases.narrative: RFI-183 adds emergency gas shutoff valves in two science rooms. Plumbing sub sent pricing by email.
cases.scope_context: Drawing P-220 shows gas outlets at lab benches with no room shutoff.

subcontractor_quotes.text:
Per RFI-183, here is our price for the two gas shutoffs:

  - Emergency gas shutoff valve with button: 2 ea x $1,385.00 = $2,770.00
  - Gas piping and fittings: 1 ls x $940.00 = $940.00
  - Plumber: 18 hr x $92.00 = $1,656.00

Subtotal $5,366.00. OH&P 15% on our work ($804.90). Total $6,170.90.

Thanks,
Cascade Plumbing estimating

cases.title: Locker room bench relocation
cases.narrative: Owner moved the locker room benches. Includes 10 hours of coordination by J. Park, who manages this project for the CM day to day.
cases.scope_context: Drawing A-140 shows benches along the north wall.

cases.narrative: Owner asked for four added hose bibbs at the courtyard, done on T&M. Sub's email says the tags were signed by its own foreman.
